summary: Observation tower on Pipestem Knob in Pipestem Resort State Park, Summers County; renamed for Steve Bolar in 2011. Build date and design not found.

facts.status_note: Present-tense descriptions in the marker and park guides; no recent condition report found

access.note: Inside Pipestem Resort State Park; no hours or climbing rules found in the sources read

visit.trail_note: Pipestem Knob Trail, 0.2 miles one way, paved and rather steep; a trail guide calls the route a switchback-laden access path

events.note: Renamed the Bolar Lookout Tower from the Pipestem Tower; dedication set for Wednesday, October 19, 2011

notes_for_editor: Record had no county; sources put the tower in Summers County inside Pipestem Resort State Park (Wikipedia notes the park straddles the Mercer/Summers line). Only OSM (way 611319752, which names it Bolar Lookout Tower, tower type observation) is in our record; the FFLA state list we checked has no Bolar or Pipestem entry. No build year, height or design found; the 2011 articles are the only dated sources. Status and climbability rest on present-tense or undated marker and guide text. Search snippets for a three-story wooden tower (athensweknew.net) were not fetched and are not used. A current check with WV State Parks would settle hours and access. Trail length conflict left open: ActionHub gives 0.2 miles one way (the story uses this); Turnbull's Pipestem Knob Trail entry gives 0.5 km, out-and-back (about 0.16 miles one way). The story does not resolve it.
